title: 22.4 A 32-to-50Gb/s/pin Single-Ended PAM-4 Transmitter with a ZQ-Based FFE and PAM-4 LSB DBI-DC Encoding
problem: Single-ended PAM-4 signaling for memory interfaces suffers from reduced signal-level spacing (1/3 of normal), reducing SNR and making high-bandwidth feed-forward equalization challenging; power-reduction encoding schemes add circuit complexity.
motivation: AI data center demand drives need for high-speed processor-memory interfaces (32-50Gb/s) with limited channel bandwidth; PAM-4 increases bits-per-baud but requires robust equalization and power optimization.
method: High-bandwidth PAM-4 transmitter with ZQ-based feed-forward equalizer (FFE) for SNR recovery and PAM-4 least-significant-bit DBI-DC encoding for power reduction with minimal hardware overhead.
key_novelty: ZQ-based FFE and PAM-4 LSB DBI-DC encoding combining equalization robustness with efficient power-bus encoding.
contributions: Minimal circuit overhead for data-bus encoding
primary_theme: High-speed PAM-4 transmitter for AI data center memory links
